name: Accidents
overview: Scripture reveals that life is sacred and protected by God's justice, as seen in His requirement for accountability for the shedding of blood (Genesis 9:5) and the allowance of self-defense without guilt (Exodus 22:2). While dangers and temptations come, including those led by the Spirit and the devil (Matthew 4:1), believers are assured of God's preservation from evil (Psalms 121:7). The call to love God fully and love others (Luke 10:27) shapes our response to unforeseen harm, while the Holy Spirit guides and teaches us through all circumstances (John 14:26).
